expected_reason: It refuses 60% of entirely harmless questions, so most users cannot get an answer at all.
truth_notes: Declared NO_GO on usefulness BEFORE any run. Stated plainly: over_refusal is a 0.05-weight criterion and answer_match a 0.30-0.40-weight one, neither a hard gate, so GreenLit's weighted score can stay above 0.80. A GO here is a plausible false GO caused by the weights, and this app exists to expose it.
